show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Private Equity Masters:  Paul Salem – Providence Equity Partners (Capital Allocators, EP.175)
summary:
This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Paul joined Providence when it was a $171 million media-focused boutique in 1992 and became
an integral part of the firm's growth and success ever since until retiring a year ago. And so in that trajectory from four or five of you at $100 million and then $350 to
$400 million to $4,8, $12 billion funds, where did the growth internally come easily?
